notes: v0.18.7: Manually reorder pinned VRChat friends with compact up/down rows directly on floating Social without jumping scroll positions. Add separate opt-in Android notifications for observed pinned-friend offline-to-online transitions: first complete snapshot silently seeds each account, newly pinned friends do not falsely notify, overlay polling runs about every 2.5-5 minutes, and WorkManager checks about every 15 minutes when floating tools are closed (Android may delay). Enable/disable from Social or the main Companion notification settings; permission handling and account-scoped state preserved. Retains v0.18.6 floating PTT button, OSC quick controls, bookmarks, verified rank-based chatboxes, Mini-VRCX and Mobile Node. No Main Launcher or Relay update required.
